identitySignals: The organization's own site lists Lodestar (TK-5 and 6-12) as one of the four schools run by Lighthouse Community Public Schools, matching the agenda name 'Lodestar: A Lighthouse Community Charter Public School'
Located in Oakland, CA, consistent with an OUSD Measures N and H (Oakland college and career pathways) agreement and with OUSD classroom and academic program contracts
ProPublica lists Lighthouse Community Public Schools in Oakland, CA with EIN 94-3370410, the same tax ID stated on the organization's own website
research.notes: The agenda names the school (Lodestar), not the network. Lodestar appears to be operated by the nonprofit Lighthouse Community Public Schools, but the exact contracting legal entity (the network versus a separate Lodestar charter entity) was not confirmed. The agenda gives no location and no page mentioning OUSD was found. Web search quota was exhausted, so only direct page fetches were used. No California entity number or SAM UEI was checked. Phone omitted because the listed lines are school-campus numbers, not a clear main line. Reviewer should verify the legal entity before publishing.

profile.summary: Lighthouse Community Public Schools is a nonprofit that runs public charter schools in East Oakland, California. It operates Lighthouse and Lodestar schools serving transitional kindergarten through 12th grade, and also offers expanded learning and summer school programs.

sources.title: Lighthouse Community Public Schools - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica
